notes: This manifest records a focal iOS Simulator reduction for FLOW-IOS-LAYOUT.

The test mounts the production IosAuthenticatedHostRouter, common top chrome and common primary navigation with a local inert Feed controller. It creates no session, repository, backend request or remote mutation.

On Xcode 26.6 and the iPhone Simulator 26.5, XCTest observed the app window at 390x844 portrait, 844x390 landscape and 390x844 restored portrait. In every phase, top chrome, content and primary navigation had positive frames; content began below top chrome, ended above primary navigation and all three frames remained within the app window.

The automated assertions cover app-window containment and vertical non-overlap. The three retained screenshots are ios-shell-layout-portrait, ios-shell-layout-landscape and ios-shell-layout-restored-portrait; the landscape capture visually shows horizontal gutters without content overlap, but this is not general automated safe-area-inset coverage.

The signed build artifact came from b541856ec72b0a5826609b76edb126c11bfc3b09. Runtime and XCTest sources are byte-identical at Product/Evidence SHA 1a8d565f8b185fd17820a30a29643f3b514147db; only documentation, the focal runner/contract, its redactor and capability metadata changed. Per the recertification policy, the exact-head focal XCTest was repeated without rebuilding or rerunning unrelated matrices solely for the SHA change.

This evidence reduces the real iPhone host, safe-area and rotation gap for the Feed shell only. It does not certify iPad, split view, every route or override, offline-banner variants, or global keyboard layout.

Any executable, workflow, runner, source, resource, test, configuration or dependency change after productSha invalidates this evidence and requires the affected evidence to be repeated.
